jobs.title: Junior Housekeeping Supervisor (f/m/d)
jobs.company: Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz
jobs.description:
Under a name steeped in tradition, Kempinski, hoteliers since 1897, has travelled the world in search of fascinating destinations without ever forgetting its traditions and European heritage. The lavish resorts as well as the stylish city and wellness hotels reflect an individual and unique character, especially for guests who appreciate 5-star service and luxury when travelling for business or pleasure. Do you have an eye for detail and work in an organised and precise manner even in stressful situations? We are looking for you to join our dynamic and highly motivated housekeeping team for the coming winter season 2026/27! | Key Responsibilities: Together with our Housekeeping Executive and her team, you will keep our elegant rooms, luxurious suites and residences, as well as the meeting rooms in perfect condition day after day.
• Supporting the Room Attendants in checking the cleanliness and tidiness of the rooms
• Supporting in checking the rooms and the entire hotel areas
• Ensuring the care and maintenance of hotel inventory and work equipment
• Receiving and organising guest requests and providing appropriate advice
• Supporting the daily distribution of work
• Adhering to quality standards
• Conducting practical training
• Carrying out various reports
• Assisting with the planning of basic cleaning
• Representing the Housekeeping Supervisors in their absence | Job Requirements:
• Successfully completed specialist training and initial professional experience
• Professional competence, creativity and attention to detail, as well as very high quality awareness
• Structured and organised way of working
• Great interest in team-oriented work
• Very good knowledge of German and English
• Knowledge of Italian is an advantage | We offer:
• Live and work in the heart of the Engadine Alps
• A wide range of creative opportunities
• Pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team
• International career prospects and development opportunities
• Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski Hotels
• Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel incl. washing facilities, fitness communal room and a wide range of meals in our staff restaurant. Laundry facilities, fitness communal room, kitchen and a wide range of meals in our staff restaurant
• Free use of the in-house childcare centre for employees' children
• Monthly employee activities such as skiing, snowboarding and cross-country skiing courses, hiking excursions, spa evenings and German courses
• Internal ‘Feel Good Committee’ to help shape all welfare issues

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Les stations balnéaires somptueuses ainsi que les élégants hôtels de ville et de bien-être reflètent un caractère individuel et unique, en particulier pour les clients qui apprécient le service 5 étoiles et le luxe lors de voyages d'affaires ou de plaisir. Principales responsabilités: Avec notre responsable du ménage et son équipe, vous garderez nos chambres élégantes, suites et résidences luxueuses, ainsi que les salles de réunion en parfait état jour après jour.
• Aider les préposés à la chambre à vérifier la propreté et la douceur des chambres
• Soutien à la vérification des chambres et de l'ensemble de l'hôtel
• Assurer les soins et l'entretien de l'inventaire hôtelier et du matériel de travail
• Réception et organisation des demandes des clients et fourniture de conseils appropriés
• Soutenir la distribution quotidienne des travaux
• Respect des normes de qualité
• Formation pratique
• Réalisation de divers rapports
• Aider à la planification du nettoyage de base
• Représenter les superviseurs internes en leur absence.
• Formation spécialisée réussie et expérience professionnelle initiale
• Compétence professionnelle, créativité et attention aux détails, ainsi qu'une sensibilisation de très haute qualité
• Mode de travail structuré et organisé
• Un grand intérêt pour le travail en équipe
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais
• La connaissance de l'italien est un avantage.
• Vivre et travailler au cœur des Alpes Engadines
• Un large éventail d'opportunités créatives
• Ambiance de travail agréable dans une équipe jeune et dynamique
• Perspectives de carrière internationales et possibilités de développement
• Avantages sociaux exceptionnels dans tous les hôtels Kempinski
• Hébergement du personnel dans les environs immédiats de l'hôtel, y compris des installations de lavage, salle de fitness commune et une large gamme de repas dans notre restaurant du personnel. Blanchisserie, salle commune de fitness, cuisine et une large gamme de repas dans notre restaurant du personnel
• Utilisation gratuite du centre de garde d'enfants pour les enfants des employés
• Activités mensuelles des employés telles que le ski, le snowboard et les cours de ski de fond, les excursions de randonnée, les soirées spa et les cours d'allemand
• Interne « Bonne commission » pour aider à façonner toutes les questions de bien-être

jobs.title: Florist (f/m/d)

Under a name steeped in tradition, Kempinski, hoteliers since 1897, has traveled the world in search of fascinating destinations, without ever forgetting its traditions and European heritage. The spacious resorts and stylish city and wellness hotels reflect an individual and unique character, especially for guests who appreciate 5-star service and luxury on their business or private trips. What actually makes a grand hotel? It is ahead of its time, creating and nurturing traditions. Would you like to develop your own traditions and strengthen the positioning of your department as a sporty, inviting, warm, and refreshingly uncomplicated 5-star hotel? Do you have an eye for detail and work creatively and independently? We are looking for you as a florist to support our housekeeping team for the upcoming winter-season 2026/2027! | Key Responsibilities:
• Responsible for floral decorations throughout the hotel (rooms, spa, restaurants, event rooms, and all public areas)
• Responsible for designing and planning decorations for events (birthdays, gala dinners, New Year's Eve celebrations, etc.)
• Preparation of floral decorations based on guest requests
• Care and maintenance of cut flowers and plants
• Determination of material consumption, price calculation, ordering and receiving goods, handling internal inquiries and orders
• Overall budget management for the floristry department | Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:
• Completed training as a florist
• Professional experience in a similar position in a comparable hotel Professional competence, creativity, and attention to detail, as well as a very high awareness of quality
• Structured and organized way of working
• Keen interest in team-oriented work
• Good knowledge of German and English | Benefits:
• Live and work in the heart of the Engadin Alps
• A wide range of creative opportunities
• A pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team
• International career prospects and development opportunities
• Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski hotels, among others
• Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, including laundry facilities, a fitness and common room, a kitchen, and a wide range of dishes in our staff restaurant

Gli spaziosi resort e gli eleganti hotel di città e benessere riflettono un carattere individuale e unico, soprattutto per gli ospiti che apprezzano il servizio a 5 stelle e il lusso sulle loro attività o viaggi privati. Hai lo scopo di raggiungere standard elevati? Sei soddisfatto solo quando i tuoi ospiti sono troppo? Sei molto motivato e apprezzi la competenza di un team ben coordinato? Siamo alla ricerca di voi per sostenere il nostro team di front office motivato dalla prossima stagione invernale 2026/2027. | Responsabilità chiave:
• Pianificare e supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane del reparto reception, compresi gli arrivi e le partenze degli ospiti, le vendite delle camere e le allocazioni delle camere per VIP, gruppi e equipaggi.
• Coordinamento e revisione del lavoro dei receptionist.
• Condurre formazione per nuovi dipendenti e formazione sul lavoro.
• Gestire richieste e reclami degli ospiti.
• Controllo dei cassieri.
• Fornire informazioni sui programmi di fidelizzazione del cliente.
• Passare alla fine del turno.
• Complemento di compiti amministrativi.
• Gestire il proprio registro di cassa con raccolta, cambio valuta, ecc.
• Preparare le fatture. | Competenze, Conoscenza e competenza:
• Formazione specialistica completata con successo
• Capacità di comunicazione e buon giudizio, così come competenze di leadership
• Conoscenza OPERA
• Competenza professionale, creatività e attenzione ai dettagli, oltre ad un elevato livello di consapevolezza della qualità
• Modo di lavoro strutturato e organizzato
• Keen interesse per il lavoro orientato al team
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese e, idealmente, italiano e/o russo. | Vantaggi:
• Vivere e lavorare nel cuore delle Alpi Engadine
• Una vasta gamma di opportunità creative
• Una piacevole atmosfera di lavoro in un team giovane e dinamico
• Prospettive internazionali di carriera e opportunità di sviluppo
• Vantaggi eccezionali dei dipendenti in tutti gli hotel Kempinski, tra gli altri
• Alloggio personale nelle immediate vicinanze dell'hotel, compresi i servizi di lavanderia, una sala fitness e comune, una cucina e una vasta gamma di piatti nel nostro ristorante personale
• Uso gratuito del centro diurno interno per i bambini dipendenti
• Attività mensili dei dipendenti quali sci, snowboard e sci di fondo, escursioni, serate spa e corsi di tedesco
• Interno «Comitato Buono» per contribuire a plasmare tutte le questioni di benessere
descriptionByLocale.en:
Under a name steeped in tradition, Kempinski, hoteliers since 1897, has travelled the world in search of fascinating destinations, without ever forgetting its traditions and European heritage. The spacious resorts and stylish city and wellness hotels reflect an individual and unique character, especially for guests who appreciate 5-star service and luxury on their business or private trips. Do you aim to reach high standards? Are you only satisfied when your guests are too? Are you highly motivated and do you value the expertise of a well-coordinated team? We are looking for you to support our motivated front office team from the coming winter season 2026/2027. | Key Responsibilities:
• Planning and supervising the daily operations of the reception department, including guest arrivals and departures, room sales, and room allocations for VIPs, groups, and crews.
• Coordinating and reviewing the work of receptionists.
• Conducting training for new employees and on-the-job training.
• Handling guest requests and complaints.
• Supervising cashiers.
• Providing information about customer loyalty programmes.
• Handing over at the end of the shift.
• Completing administrative tasks.
• Managing your own cash register with collection, currency exchange, etc.
• Preparing invoices. | Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:
• Successfully completed specialist training
• Communication skills and good judgement, as well as leadership skills
• OPERA knowledge
• Professional competence, creativity and attention to detail, as well as a very high level of quality awareness
• Structured and organised way of working
• Keen interest in team-oriented work
• Very good knowledge of German and English and, ideally, Italian and/or Russian. | Benefits:
• Live and work in the heart of the Engadin Alps
• A wide range of creative opportunities
• A pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team
• International career prospects and development opportunities
• Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski hotels, among others
• Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, including laundry facilities, a fitness and common room, a kitchen and a wide range of dishes in our staff restaurant
• Free use of the in-house daycare centre for employee children
• Monthly employee activities such as skiing, snowboarding and cross-country skiing courses, hiking trips, spa evenings and German courses
• Internal ‘Feel Good Committee’ to help shape all welfare issues

jobs.title: Pizza Chef (f/m/d)
jobs.company: Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz
jobs.description:
The Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski will host the remarkable Billionaire Dinner Show. The event, which already takes place year-round in Dubai and in summer at its historic location in Porto Cervo and at the legendary Sporting in Monte Carlo, will now expand its presence to St. Moritz. Billionaire, part of the Majestas Group, is a premier destination for luxury dining, entertainment and exclusive experiences for all our guests at the world's most exclusive venues. Combining exceptional cuisine, breathtaking ambience and unparalleled service, we cater to the world's elite, offering a unique blend of sophistication and excitement every evening. To support our kitchen team, we are looking for you as a seasonal pizza chef for the winterseason 2026/2027. In this role, you will learn the unique recipe for the famous ‘Crazy Pizza’. | Key Responsibilities: Your main task is to create pizzas according to the well-known recipes of ‘Crazy Pizza’ and to ensure that every pizza meets our high quality and freshness standards. In addition to maintaining a spotless kitchen, you will work closely with the head chef, gain valuable insights from team feedback and continuously expand your culinary expertise. Your daily work:
• Making and kneading homemade pizza dough
• Supervising the preparation of ingredients by the pizza team (cleaning vegetables, preparing sauces and toppings)
• Supporting and training newly hired pizza team members
• Monitoring and executing customer orders for pizza
• Making pizzas by hand and baking them professionally in the oven
• Keeping the kitchen, oven and utensils clean in accordance with HACCP regulations
• Improving the customer experience through skilful acrobatic pizza tossing | Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:
• You have an EU/EFTA identity card
• Previous relevant experience in a similar role and in a fast-paced environment.
• Exceptional service standards with attention to detail.
• Passion for hospitality with a friendly demeanour and a smile.
• Good English skills with the ability to communicate confidently.
• Ability to work under pressure and willingness to work in a team.
• Willingness to work full-time and be flexible. | Benefits:
• Live and work in the heart of the Engadin Alps
• A wide range of creative opportunities
• A pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team
• International career prospects and development opportunities
• Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski hotels, among others
• Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, including laundry facilities, a fitness and common room, a kitchen and a wide range of dishes in our staff restaurant
• Free use of the in-house daycare centre for employee children

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sous un nom empreint de tradition, Kempinski, hôtelier depuis 1897, a parcouru le monde à la recherche de destinations fascinantes, sans jamais oublier ses traditions et son patrimoine européen. Les stations balnéaires spacieuses et les hôtels de ville et de bien-être élégants reflètent un caractère individuel et unique, particulièrement pour les clients qui apprécient le service 5 étoiles et le luxe dans leurs voyages d'affaires ou privés. Êtes-vous passionné par l'hospitalité ? L'esprit de service, la sensibilisation à la qualité, la flexibilité et l'apparence soignée sont-ils parmi vos attributs? Nous sommes à votre recherche pour soutenir notre équipe de relations d'invités motivées à partir de la prochaine saison d'hiver 2026/2027! Principales responsabilités :
• Arrivée/sortie (particuliers et groupes)
• Accueil et assistance aux clients de l'hôtel
• Préparation pour les arrivées VIP
• Préparation des factures
• Gestion de la caisse enregistreuse avec recouvrement des paiements, change, etc.
• Réception et traitement des demandes de renseignements
• Diverses tâches administratives de réception

• Formation spécialisée réussie et, idéalement, expérience professionnelle initiale

• Compétence professionnelle, créativité et attention au détail, ainsi qu'un niveau très élevé de sensibilisation à la qualité
• Mode de travail structuré et organisé
• Intérêt pour le travail en équipe
• Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais; compétences linguistiques supplémentaires sont un avantage.

• Un large éventail d'opportunités créatives
• Une ambiance de travail agréable dans une équipe jeune et dynamique

• Hébergement du personnel à proximité immédiate de l'hôtel, y compris la buanderie, une salle de fitness et une salle commune, une cuisine et un large éventail de plats dans notre restaurant du personnel
• Utilisation gratuite de la garderie pour enfants employés
• Activités mensuelles des employés telles que le ski, le snowboard et les cours de ski de fond, les randonnées, les soirées spa et les cours d'allemand

jobs.title: Roomservice Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.company: Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz
jobs.description:
Under a name steeped in tradition, Kempinski, hoteliers since 1897, has traveled the world in search of fascinating destinations, without ever forgetting its traditions and European heritage. The spacious resorts and stylish city and wellness hotels reflect an individual and unique character, especially for guests who appreciate 5-star service and luxury on their business or private trips. Our in-room dining experience includes 24-hour service from breakfast to lunch to midnight snacks with the “order what you like” concept. Do you have an eye for detail and work creatively and independently? We are looking for you to manage our room service as Room Service Manager during the winter season 2026/2027. | Key Responsibilities:
• Management of the room service and banquet department
• Management of a team of approximately 10 employees
• Coordination and operational implementation of room service activities
• Ensuring the timely and correct delivery of food and beverages to guests
• Management of personnel
• Control of orders
• Ensuring guest satisfaction
• Cooperation with the kitchen and front desk
• Maintaining inventory and ensuring high quality standards
• Ensuring an excellent guest experience with a focus on quality and hygiene standards
• Responsibility for recruitment, training, and development of the team
• Creating the monthly duty roster
• Placing orders, conducting inventories, and closing daily accounts | Skills, Knowledge and Expertise:
• Completed training and at least 3 years of professional experience in a similar position in a comparable hotel
• Attention to detail
• Experience in leading a team
• Keen interest in team-oriented work
• Resilience, professional competence, tidiness, and a very high awareness of quality
• Structured and organized way of working
• Guest-oriented work and economic action
• English and German are required, other languages, such as Italian, are an advantage | Benefits:
• Live and work in the heart of the Engadin Alps
• A wide range of creative opportunities
• A pleasant working atmosphere in a young and dynamic team
• International career prospects and development opportunities
• Outstanding employee benefits in all Kempinski hotels, among others
• Staff accommodation in the immediate vicinity of the hotel, including laundry facilities, a fitness and common room, a kitchen, and a wide range of dishes in our staff restaurant
• Free use of the in-house daycare center for employees' children
• Monthly employee activities such as skiing, snowboarding, and cross-country skiing courses, hiking trips, spa evenings, and German courses
• Internal “Feel Good Committee” to help shape all welfare issues

jobs.title: Regional Manager, E-commerce & Digital Strategy, Europe
jobs.company: Corporate Offices
jobs.description:
We are seeking a versatile and dynamic professional to join our Geneva Corporate Office. This role is the operational backbone of regional digital performance. As Regional Manager, E-commerce Digital Strategy, you execute the regional digital strategy set by the global team based on your recommendations and provide hands-on support, training, and day-to-day guidance to on-property teams. You are the go-to expert for hotels navigating paid media, web performance, and digital best practices, translating strategic direction into practical action, and ensuring properties have the tools, knowledge, and support to hit their performance goals. | Key Responsibilities:
• Regional Digital Strategy: Collaborate with global teams and Senior Director, Global E -commerce on defining the regional strategy for Europe; Implement the regional digital strategy and priorities set at the beginning of the year, translating high-level direction into concrete action plans for on-property teams.
• Digital Performance Monitoring: Conduct monthly tracking, performance reviews, and annual budget reviews for the region; Set hotel goals for the year in line with regional and global KPIs;Prepare reports and highlight areas needing attention or escalation; Drive hotels to define action plans in case of performance shortfalls.
• Owned Channels Performance (Kempinski.com Mobile App) : Lead digital initiatives to drive performance on the brand online platforms through:
• Traffic acquisition – Setting paid media campaigns, source market prioritization, agile demand capture, use cases, SEO/GEO focus
• Web share protection – Overseeing rate parity strategy in collaboration with RM, engaging both hotel and corporate leadership
• Conversion – Aligning digital campaigns with commercial go-to-market strategy, directing hotel content audits, guiding brand landing page improvements to ensure regional relevance and localization
• Loyalty – Amplifying GHA campaigns, ensuring commercial leverage of the loyalty program
• Accountability – Setting and following up on goals on several relevant digital KPIs and running targeted audits of selected properties.
• Day-to-Day Hotel Support: Serve as the first point of contact for on-property teams digital questions, troubleshooting issues and providing tactical guidance on web, app, and campaign execution; Animate the regional digital community through weekly and monthly calls, setting clear performance goals for on-property teams and fostering a culture of shared accountability and continuous improvement.
• Paid Media Campaign Coordination: Support the execution of regional paid media campaigns and initiatives, coordinating timelines and assets with hotels and agencies; Provide strategic recommendations on hotel level media campaigns to maximize qualified traffic, ROI, and direct revenue across all 20+ properties; Monitor region performance of paid media investment in partnership with paid media agency and Global Paid Media Manager.
• Training Onboard
